prompt:

Header text verbatim: "betydelse". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "importance".
Scene: A well-rested adult waking refreshed, with sleep represented as the central piece in a simple wellbeing puzzle.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "betydelse = importance; picture something that really matters.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Sömn har stor betydelse för hälsan.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
